description: This file defines an Android activity (ContentInfoActivity) that implements a TV content information screen using Jetpack Compose. It displays various UI elements such as title, metadata, description, and a row of interactive action buttons with focus management and key event handling for a TV environment.

classes.name: ContentInfoActivity
classes.description: Android activity that displays detailed info about TV content, including title, metadata, description, and action buttons with TV focus interactions.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, retrieves data from intent extras, and sets the Compose UI content.

methods.name: onKeyDown
methods.description: Handles back button press to finish activity.

methods.name: ContentInfoScreen
methods.description: Main composable function rendering the content info screen with focusable elements and action buttons.

methods.name: MetaText
methods.description: Composable for rendering metadata text elements.

methods.name: MetaDivider
methods.description: Composable rendering a separator between metadata items.

methods.name: Badge
methods.description: Composable for rendering badge UI elements with background and text.

methods.name: ActionItem
methods.description: Data class representing an action button's icon and label.

methods.name: ActionPillButton
methods.description: Interactive composable button with focus and key event handling for TV remote control.
